text:
The three adjacent pairs are Ben–Finn, Hana–Ivo, and Elif–Ann. Exactly one seat separates Gus and Hana, and Gus is before Ivo, so the only fit is Gus, then one person, then Hana, then Ivo.

That middle seat cannot be Ben, Finn, Elif, or Ann, because each of those is locked to a partner on the other side. It also cannot be Dev, because Hana is before Dev. The middle seat is Cara: Gus, Cara, Hana, Ivo in four straight slots. Ivo’s earliest seat is therefore 4.

Elif is at least four slots after Hana (so that Elif, Ann, and Ivo all clear Hana/Ivo), and Ann follows Elif. Dev sits after Hana and before Ben. The only line that satisfies all of that is slots 1–4 as Gus–Cara–Hana–Ivo, Dev in 5, Ben–Finn in 6–7, and Elif–Ann in 8–9. Starting the Gus block later leaves no room for Elif–Ann.

SCHEDULE: {"1":"Gus","2":"Cara","3":"Hana","4":"Ivo","5":"Dev","6":"Ben","7":"Finn","8":"Elif","9":"Ann"}
CONFIDENCE: 97
